LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING: FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading: Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading: Fluency, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read fluently? 2. How does the appropriate use of verbal and non- verbal cues enhance reading fluency?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading: Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: A learner builds on own learning experiences by listening and modelling fluent reading.

● Self-efficacy: A learners document- success criteria while timing themselves as they read excerpts in pairs.

● Communication and collaboration: A learner speaks clearly and effectively when reciting a choral verse.

Values:
● Responsibility: A learner read texts on drug and substance abuse prevention.

● Respect: A learner achieves as learners listen to their peers’ reading.

Link to other subjects

● Performing arts: fluent reading is essential in drama and poem recitations.

● All languages emphasise fluent reading.

Suggested Learning Resources

Audio-visual clips, braille and print reading materials
